description: Na₄MgCr₂O₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Amm2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.33 Å) and two longer (2.56 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.58 Å. Mg is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.95 Å) and two longer (1.98 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. All Cr-O bond lengths are 1.81 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.66 Å) and two longer (1.68 Å) Cr-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Cr atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Cr atom to form a mixture of distorted edge and face-sharing ONa₃MgCr trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Cr atom.
